visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier quality bar throughout: warm off-white studio backdrop, no floor grid, no glow, no bloom, no emissive materials, no cartoon outlines. A long low shelf (warm ivory slab) holds the eight planet spheres standing on it in size order, Mercury left to Jupiter right, each with a slim label plane underneath giving its × Earth radius. The Sun floats behind the shelf at the same scale, warm cream, reading as a much larger sibling rather than a glowing ball. The volume-fill toggle animates hundreds of tiny Earth-colored spheres cascading into Jupiter's volume. Planet colors are the branch's muted set; the amber reference tag, the filling Earth-spheres, and the hotspot dots are the only saturated accents. Auto-rotate is slow and pauses when the volume toggle is filling.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, roughness ~0.55-0.65 matte spheres with baked mottling/banding, no image textures. Shelf: warm ivory matte (roughness 0.7). Labels: dark warm-grey text sprites. Volume-fill spheres: small instances of the Earth color at low opacity in the middle of the fill. No emissive channels.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: A size-comparison shelf along X at y=0.1. Planet display radii in scene units (Earth = 0.24): Mercury 0.09 at x=-2.75, Mars 0.13 at -1.85, Venus 0.23 at -1.35, Earth 0.24 at -0.85, Neptune 0.94 at 0.6, Uranus 0.96 at 1.15, Saturn 2.18 at 1.85 (with ring discs slightly larger), Jupiter 2.64 at 2.55. Shelf slab: 7.0 wide, 0.06 thick, 1.1 deep, warm ivory. Label planes (slim, y≈-0.05) under each sphere: 'Mercury 0.38×', 'Mars 0.53×', 'Venus 0.95×', 'Earth 1×', 'Neptune 3.9×', 'Uranus 4.0×', 'Saturn 9.1×', 'Jupiter 11×'. Sun sphere radius 4.5 at (0, 1.6, -2.0), behind and above the shelf so it reads clearly on rotation; label 'Sun 109×'. Earth reference: small amber ring on the ground beneath Earth's sphere. Volume-fill toggle: when on, animate ~1,000 small Earth-blue spheres filling Jupiter's sphere over ~4s, with a counter '0…1,331 Earths' beside the hs-volume-note card. Default camera [0, 1.1, 6.4] → target [0, 0.3, 0]; slow auto-rotate (~30s/rev) pausing during the fill animation. Grounding: radial ground-shadow beneath the shelf. Named groups per layers list.
